title: 统一错误响应：按 RFC 9457（Problem Details）生成 application/problem+json 文档，含校验错误扩展成员
expected_output:
response#0
  HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Content
  Content-Type: application/problem+json
  Retry-After: -
  body={"type":"https://api.example.com/problems/validation-failed","title":"Unprocessable Content","status":422,"detail":"The request body failed schema validation.","instance":"/articles","errors":[{"pointer":"/title","detail":"must be a non-empty string of at most 40 characters"},{"pointer":"/status","detail":"must be one of draft, published"}]}
response#1
  HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
  Content-Type: application/problem+json
  Retry-After: -
  body={"type":"https://api.example.com/problems/article-not-found","title":"Not Found","status":404,"detail":"Article 999 does not exist.","instance":"/articles/999"}
response#2
  HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
  Content-Type: application/problem+json
  Retry-After: -
  body={"type":"https://api.example.com/problems/slug-conflict","title":"Conflict","status":409,"detail":"An article with the same slug already exists.","instance":"/articles"}
response#3
  HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
  Content-Type: application/problem+json
  Retry-After: 30
  body={"type":"https://api.example.com/problems/rate-limit-exceeded","title":"Too Many Requests","status":429,"detail":"Request quota exceeded for this client.","instance":"/articles","retryAfterSec":30}
response#4
  HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
  Content-Type: application/problem+json
  Retry-After: -
  body={"type":"about:blank","title":"Service Unavailable","status":503,"detail":"The database is unreachable.","instance":"/health"}
structure_checks:
  status=422 core_fields_ok=true type_is_uri_reference=true extension_members=["errors"] no_core_clash=true
  status=404 core_fields_ok=true type_is_uri_reference=true extension_members=[] no_core_clash=true
  status=409 core_fields_ok=true type_is_uri_reference=true extension_members=[] no_core_clash=true
  status=429 core_fields_ok=true type_is_uri_reference=true extension_members=["retryAfterSec"] no_core_clash=true
  status=503 core_fields_ok=true type_is_uri_reference=true extension_members=[] no_core_clash=true
all_core_fields_ok=true
